title: Persisted formats and shipped migration boundary

requirements.initial: Shipped state has pending or already applied migration entries.
requirements.action: Apply the chain twice and inject a failure.
requirements.expected: Applied ids are durable, repeated runs are no-ops, and failed ids are not recorded.

evidence.assertion: halts on failure; journal is NOT updated for the failed migration
evidence.scope: Failure boundary in the real runner.

requirements.gap: Per-shipped-version data fixtures and backup/restore need evidence beyond the generic runner.

requirements.initial: A persisted Session has an AI binding and display name.
requirements.action: Update its name or paused binding and reload it.
requirements.expected: Independent dossier fields survive the update.

evidence.assertion: keeps the AI binding when replacing a paused Session binding
evidence.scope: Real temporary store; no installed prior-version app.

requirements.gap: Map all shipped persisted formats incrementally; this representative dossier is not the whole data catalog.

requirements.initial: A TUI edits Project or Machine settings while the shared Default may be null.
requirements.action: Validate and persist settings through the terminal.
requirements.expected: Actual settings change without inventing an explicit CLI override or changing Default; successful writes report accurately.

evidence.assertion: edits and persists selected-AliceProject settings inside the TUI
evidence.scope: Real Node CLI/PTY and isolated config files; no native Electron or broker.

evidence.assertion: switches setup scope and persists machine defaults inside the TUI
evidence.scope: Real Node CLI/PTY and isolated config files; no native Electron or broker.

requirements.gap: Platform-specific installed clients and interrupted filesystem writes are not proved by these terminal assertions.
